_help.shots: stage names a staging function in render_stills.py. camera (optional) replaces that stage's camera: location and target in metres, lens in mm.
_help.looks: lights is 'shot' (keep the stage's own lights) or a list of area lights placed relative to the camera and the staged beans.
_help.light: azimuth in degrees around the beans: 0 = at the camera, 90 = camera right, 180 = behind the beans. distance and size are multiples of the camera distance. energy in watts = strength x distance squared, so one look keeps its exposure across shots of different scale.
_help.materials: overrides by material name from render_stills.py: 'Belt blue', 'Warm stone', 'Frame black', 'Brushed steel', 'Inspection diffuser'.

picks.note: All three looks can be used together. Clay and blueprint use one material, so they cannot show colour defects such as black beans.

conveyor-low.note: Same staging, low 60 mm camera at the belt end looking upstream, mild depth of field.

lab-daylight.note: Control. The delivered lighting and materials, unchanged.

high-key.note: Bright lab product style. Light grey belt differs from the simulator's blue belt.

warm-roastery.note: Warm window light, dark warm belt. Belt colour differs from the simulator.

noir-rim.note: Near-black set, cool rim from behind, small warm key. Black rubber belt differs from the simulator.

blueprint.note: Technical drawing style: one blue material plus Freestyle outlines. A style option, not a realism proof.
